message:
feat(standby): a session entry activated by its lease -- standby_adopt + StandbySessionLink (keepalive-r2 2 e, model A)

The product call site of the runner contract: a tap makes a NEW session entry and connects it with the lease's
activation through the entry's own connect gate. The arguments are used once -- Connect, or Abandon when the operation
went stale before the connect or Connect refused before its worker (the lease closes the handle and reads its socket
again). After every Disconnect of the entry (the gate's stale disconnect, CloseIfOwn, the entry's Close) the link says
SessionOver of exactly that activation, once. Disconnect joins the worker and the video reader (StopWorker) first.

e2e --product-client --real-directory --old-host: 74/74 (8 new: stale before connect, Connect refused, adopted by
activation with video, closed as the bridge closes it -> parked again on the same socket, a second Over says nothing,
the host sees the end, the lease keeps pinging).
